source: 659 Poor “Monster”
target: 659 Pauper “Monstrum”

source: Observing Camus’s expression, as if compelled to act at gunpoint, Lumian didn’t hold back.
target: Vultum Camus observans, quasi ad agendum sub coercitione sclopetorum, Lumian non retinuit.

source: He replied with a smile, “I’d like that.”
target: Risus in ore habens, respondit: “Placet mihi.”

source: It was evident to him that the brass of the patrol team, or even Admiral Querarill himself, was concerned about Louis Berry wandering around their territory.
target: Ei patebat quod magistratus cohortis vigiliae, vel etiam ipse Admiral Querarill, de vagatione Louis Berry in eorum territorio solliciti essent.

source: Tizamo, where he was headed, was located near the primitive forest and had close ties to a Sequence 5 Desire Apostle.
target: Tizamo, quo se dirigebat, prope silvam rudimentariam sita erat et nexūs proximos habebat cum Apostolo Desiderii Sequenciae V.

source: Therefore, two additional patrol team members with a certain relationship with Louis Berry were sent to accompany him.
target: Ergo duo sodales additi cohortis vigiliae, qui cum Louis Berry aliquo nexū coniuncti erant, ad eum comitandum missi sunt.

source: Even if they couldn’t prevent trouble, they could at least send word before it became a catastrophe.
target: Etiamsi incommoda vitare non possent, saltem nuntium mittere poterant antequam calamitas oriretur.

source: As for why they didn’t directly stop Louis Berry from heading to Tizamo Town, it was partly because Lumian had hinted at the faction backing him when he submitted Twanaku’s head.
target: Quoad causam cur Louis Berry directe prohiberi ne ad oppidum Tizamo perveniret, partim quia Lumian, cum caput Twanaku exhiberet, factionem sibi favorem insinuaverat.

source: Without a conflict of principles, Admiral Querarill likely wouldn’t make things difficult for him.
target: Sine conflictu principiis, Admiral Querarill verisimiliter res ei non complicaret.

source: Secondly, Louis Berry’s investigations and adventures seemed to bring calamity, but they had exposed hidden dangers ahead of time.
target: Secundo, inquisitiones et casus Louis Berry calamitatem parere videbantur, sed ante tempus pericula occulta patefecerant.

source: If the problem remained concealed and continued to evolve, Matani and Admiral Querarill might not be able to handle it in a year or two.
target: Si quaestio abscondita maneret et evolveretur, Matani atque Admiral Querarill fortasse intra unum vel duo annos id regere non possent.

source: When the time came, blood might flow like a river.
target: Cum tempus advenisset, sanguis ut flumen effluere posset.

source: Kolobo, acting as the carriage driver, gazed ahead stonily.
target: Kolobo, vecturae auriga fungens, vultū lapideo ante se aspexit.

source: He fumbled for a pair of sunglasses and slid them onto the bridge of his nose.
target: Manū incerta, par lenticulōrum solārium quaesivit et in pontem nasi sui induxit.

source: There were no visible injuries on his body.
target: In corpore eius vulnera manifesta non erant.

source: As Camus held the carriage door open, he watched Louis Berry board, leading a young boy by the hand.
target: Dum Camus iānam vectūrae tenēbat, spectābat Louis Berry conscendere, iuvenem puerum manu ducēns.

source: “He’s going to Tizamo too?” Camus blurted in surprise.
target: “Ad Tizamo quoque itur?” in obstupore exclamāvit Camus.

source: He had assumed Louis Berry would leave his servant and godson at Hotel Orella, joining them later after dealing with Tizamo Town’s issues.
target: Putāverat Louis Berry servum atque filiolum (godson) suum ad Hotel Orella relinqueret, et postea se cum illīs iungere, rem oppidi Tizamo solvendam.

source: However, the adventurer was now bringing a young child to Tizamo, and it was evident this wasn’t a leisurely trip.
target: At vero, adventor nunc puerum parvum ad Tizamo ducebat, et patebābat iter non esse otiosum.

source: It was very dangerous!
target: Valde periculosum erat!

source: Lumian’s left foot remained on the ground, and his right foot halted at the carriage’s edge.
target: Pes sinistrum Lumiani in terra mansit, et dexter pedis ad limen vectūrae stetit.

source: He smiled and spoke, “My godson is fascinated by jungle fruits, the unique beasts I hunt, and various spices.”
target: Risus faciens et locūtus est: “Filiolus meus fascinatur fructibus silvarum, bestiīs singulāribus quās venor, et variīs condimentīs.”

source: Earlier, the Tizamons had mentioned their hometown’s specialties, highlighting the excellence of roasted meat.
target: Prius, Tizamōnēs specialitātēs patriae suā memorāverant, praecipuē excellentiam carnis assātā extollentes.

source: The blend of spices and the distinctive gamey flavor of wild beasts in the forest contributed to Tizamo Town’s unique delicacies.
target: Miscellānea condimentōrum et singularis sapor ferārum venātiōnum in silva deliciās unicas oppidi Tizamo conferebant.

source: Ludwig, already settled in the carriage, swallowed, seemingly in sync with Lumian.
target: Ludwig, iam in vectūra consedit, glūtīens videbātur in harmonia cum Lumian.

source: Aren’t you worried about endangering your godson? Why are you so confident?
target: Nonne tibi sollicitūdō est ne filiolum tuum periclitetur? Cur tam fidēns es?

source: Camus didn’t press, simply signaling Lugano with his eyes to hurry up.
target: Camus non pressit, sed oculīs Lugano significāvit, ut festinaret.

source: Lugano cast a glance at the peculiar carriage driver, who trembled slightly beneath his black sunglasses.
target: Lugano oculōs iecit in aurigam vectūrae insolitam, quī sub lenticulīs nigrīs leviter tremēre videbātur.

source: He entered the carriage and took a seat across from Lumian and Ludwig.
target: In vectūrā intrāvit atque sedem collocāvit trans Lumian et Ludwig.

source: Camus shut the carriage door and settled beside Kolobo.
target: Camus iānam vectūrae claudēns iuxta Kolobo consedit.

source: With a sigh, he remarked, “You can remove your sunglasses now. It’s been hard on you.”
target: Suspirāns inquit: “Nunc lenticulās solāriās auferre potēs; te fatigāvērunt.”

source: “Alright, alright, alright.” Kolobo seemed to shiver as if struck by an icy wind.
target: “Bene, bene, bene.” Kolobo vidēbātur tremēre, quasi ventō glaciālī percussus esset.

source: His teeth chattered, and his tremors intensified.
target: Dentēs eius crepitāvērunt, et tremōrēs eius intensī factī sunt.

source: Camus turned to him, surprised.
target: Camus ad eum conversus est, stupēns.

source: “Didn’t you strike a deal face-to-face with Louis Berry? Why are you still so afraid?”
target: “Nonne cum Louis Berry facie ad faciem stipulām fecistī? Cur adhūc tam timidus es?”

source: Not seeing him directly again!
target: Non rursus eum directe videns!

source: “Alright, alright, alright.” Kolobo removed his sunglasses, taking more than ten seconds to compose himself.
target: “Bene, bene, bene.” Kolobo lenticulās solāriās removit, et plus quam decem secundīs ad se componendum tempus tulit.

source: In a hushed tone, he confessed with fear, “I feel like my fingers, my arms, my insides, even my head… all eaten.”
target: In tono submittō, metu confitebātur: “Sentiō digitos meōs, brachīa meā, intima necnon caput meum… omnia devorāta esse.”

source: “That, that…”
target: “Id, id…”

source: “That what?” Camus struggled to comprehend why the Monster’s demeanor had shifted so drastically, sensing that the issue might be significant.
target: “Id quid?” Camus conābātur intellegere cur habitus Monstrī tantopere mutātus esset, suspiciēns rem esse magnā.

source: Kolobo swallowed hard and continued, “That… that child… is also… very dangerous!”
target: Kolobo vehementer glūtīt et continuāvit: “Id… ille puer… quoque… valde periculosus est!”

source: “Though I haven’t laid eyes on him, I sense a looming threat, like facing a lion, a tiger, a python, ready to eat me at any moment.”
target: “Quamquam eum non intueor, minam imminēns sentio, sicut cum leone, tigre, et pythone, quōvis momento mē edere parātī sint.”

source: “…” Camus was stunned, a hiss escaping his lips.
target: “…” Camus obstupuit, sibilus ex labiīs eius egressus.

source: Until now, Kolobo had never exhibited such fear except in the presence of three individuals radiating danger: Desire Apostle Twanaku with Wraith powers, and Louis Berry, capable of hunting Twanaku.
target: Usque ad hunc diem, Kolobo talem timōrem numquam ostendit, nisi coram tribūs personīs periculum emanantibus: Apostolō Desiderī Twanaku cum viribus umbrārum, et Louis Berry, quī Twanaku venārī poterat.

source: Could this boy match them?
target: An hic puer illīs aequare possit?

source: Is he also a Beyonder, perhaps a Sequence 5 Beyonder?
target: Estne etiam Beyonder, fortasse Beyonder Sequenciae V?

source: No, it’s not merely a Sequence 5 matter.
target: Non, non solum res Sequenciae V est.

source: Our patrol team’s captain is a Sequence 5, yet Kolobo never mentioned feeling such foreboding in his presence.
target: Dux cohortis vigiliae nostrā Sequenciae V est, sed Kolobo numquam talem praemonitionem in eius praesentia sensit.

source: There must be something unique about these three individuals!
target: Debet aliquid unicum de his tribūs personīs esse!

source: Regardless, the boy is undoubtedly extraordinary and hazardous!
target: Quamquam, puer indubitanter extraordinārius atque periculosus est!

source: No wonder Louis Berry is bringing his godson to Tizamo without worry.
target: Non mirum est quod Louis Berry filiolum suum ad Tizamo sine cūrā ducat.

source: Perhaps the child poses an even greater threat…
target: Fortasse puer etiam maiorem minam ponat…

source: Camus unraveled his earlier confusion, stifling his curiosity, refraining from probing further with Kolobo.
target: Camus praecedentem confusioem suam explicāvit, cūriā suā cohibēns, et ulterius cum Kolobo inquisīre abstinuit.

source: In the confines of the four-wheeled carriage, even with the barrier between them, Louis Berry caught wind of their hushed exchange!
target: In confinibus vectūrae quattuor rotārum, etiam cum intervallō inter eōs, Louis Berry eōrum tacītum colloquium didicit.

source: Considering the intel gleaned from the Fog Sea, Camus harbored suspicions that Louis Berry was a Sequence 5 Beyonder following the Hunter pathway.
target: Ex Mari Nebulae perceptīs, Camus suspicātus est Louis Berry Beyonder Sequenciae V esse, viam Venātōriam sequēns.

source: Those of this pathway were renowned for their sharp senses—exceptional vision, acute sense of smell, and keen hearing.
target: Hi, quī hanc viam sequebantur, claros sensūs habēbant—visum eximium, olfactum acutum, atque auditiam perspicacem.

source: A Beyonder of the Monster pathway is quite intriguing.
target: Beyonder viā Monstrī vere mirandus est.

source: Even without laying eyes on Ludwig or hearing his voice, Louis can sense his ominous aura, a being who devours everything…
target: Etiamsi Ludwigum nec intueātur nec vocem eius audiātur, Louis tamen eius auram ominosam sentīre potest, entem quī omnia devorat…

source: Lumian, leaning against the carriage wall, toyed with his golden straw hat, shooting Ludwig a knowing smile.
target: Lumian, ad parietem vectūrae reclinātus, pileum stramineum aureum ludēbat, Ludwig subrīdēns scienter aspiciēns.

source: Could it be that this “little child” has truly taken a liking to Kolobo and Camus?
target: Num id fieri potest ut hic “puer parvus” Kolobo atque Camus vere amātus sit?

source: Indeed. These are two Beyonders who haven’t succumbed to severe corruption.
target: Immo. Hi duo sunt Beyonder, quī corruptionī gravissimāe non cederunt.

source: Ludwig likely had a momentary lapse in control… Heh heh, Camus may not have noticed, but Kolobo reacted instantly, sensing the danger?
target: Ludwig verisimiliter brevem imperīī lapsum habuit… Heh heh, Camus fortasse non animadvērit, sed Kolobo statim, periculum sentiēns, reaguit.

source: Lumian acknowledged Ludwig with a nod.
target: Lumian, capite annuēns, Ludwigum agnovit.

source: “Well done. Your restraint is admirable.”
target: “Bene factum. Tua continentia admiranda est.”

source: Praise was due when a child behaved correctly, fostering a healthy mindset and habits!
target: Laus debita est, cum puer recte se gerit, mentem sanam et mores bona fovēns!

source: Ludwig remained silent, his expression conveying he was not to be treated as a child.
target: Ludwig tacītus mansit, vultū suō demonstrāns se non puerum esse ad tractandum.

source: A faint smile graced his lips as he retrieved a box of biscuits from his crimson school bag, nibbling on them.
target: Subtilis risus labrīs eius ornābat, dum capsulam biscuitōrum ex sacco scholae rubrō extrāxit, ea menducāns.

source: What restraint… What did he mean by “well done”…
target: Quanta continentia… Quid per “bene factum” vōlibat dicere?

source: Lugano, seated across from him, found himself perplexed.
target: Lugano, trans eum sedēns, se perplexum invenit.

source: Tizamo stood as the most remote town in Port Pylos, nestled against the edge of the primitive forest.
target: Tizamo stetit ut remotissimum oppidum in Portū Pylos, in margine silvae rudimentariae collocātum.

source: A full two hours’ journey by carriage was required to reach it.
target: Iter plenum duorum horārum vectūrae ad id perveniendum requirebātur.

source: Of course, for those in a hurry, an alternative route existed: boarding a steam locomotive from the port to Cahert, the southernmost town.
target: Certe, pro festinantibus, via alternativā exstābat: conscendēns locomotivam vaporis ab portū ad Cahert, oppidum Continentis Septentrionalis remotissimum.

source: From there, a carriage or coffin could be hired to venture northeast, shaving the travel time to Tizamo down to just an hour.
target: Ex eo, vectūra aut sarcophagus conducendī licēbat, ut ad partem septentrionem iter dūcērētur, tempus itineris ad Tizamo ad tantam ūnam horam redigendo.

source: However, Lumian showed no inclination towards haste.
target: Attamen, Lumian nulla festinātiōnis propensiō ostendit.

source: As they departed Port Pylos, the road gradually narrowed and deteriorated.
target: Cum Portum Pylos relinquerent, via paulatim angustāta atque deteriorāta est.

source: Yet, the carriage pressed on steadily.
target: At vectūra constanter pergebat.

source: Kolobo, the carriage driver, operated with precision akin to a well‑oiled machine, guiding the horses and carriage without falter.
target: Kolobo, aurīga vectūrae, cum subtilitāte quasi machīna bene uncta operābātur, equōs atque vecturam sine errōre gubernābat.

source: An hour slipped by, and the carriage wound its way through the forest.
target: Hora praeteriit, et vectūra per silvam sinuōse iter fēcit.

source: Abruptly, Lumian, pretending to slumber, snapped open his eyes.
target: Subitō, Lumian, somnum fingēns, oculōs repentina aperuit.

source: His body turned dark and spectral, melding with the shadows cast by the window.
target: Corpus eius obscūrum et spectrūm factum est, miscēns cum umbrīs a fēnēstra proiectīs.

source: Shadow Transformation!
target: Transformatio Umbrārum!

source: In an instant, gunshots pierced the forest’s tranquility.
target: In instante, sclopeta tranquillitātem silvae percusērunt.

source: Bullets whizzed from afar, some thudding into the earth, kicking up clouds of soil, while others took aim at Camus, the carriage, and the horse.
target: Globuli ferreī e longinquō volitāvērunt, quidam in terram incidēns, nubes pulveris excitāns, alīi in Camum, vecturam, atque equum destināvērunt.

source: Amidst the chaos, the horse crumpled, bleeding profusely, and the carriage toppled to the ground.
target: Inter chaos, equus corruit, sanguine profuse effūsō, et vectūra in terram cecidit.

source: Kolobo had already abandoned his perch as the driver, escaping unscathed from the barrage of gunfire.
target: Kolobo iam sedem suam ut aurīga deseruerat, et ex impetu sclopetōrum intactus evādit.

source: Camus leaped clear of the carriage in advance, crouching low, revolver in hand.
target: Camus ante vectūrām exsiluit, procumbēns, revolver in manu tenēns.

source: He maneuvered with agility, at times rolling, at others slithering deeper into the undergrowth.
target: Agiliter se movere perrexit, aliquando volvēns, aliīs vero inter subvegetātiōnem serpēns.

source: With each movement, he unleashed shots, seeking to suppress the unseen assailant.
target: Quōque motū, ictūs emittens, conābātur hostem invisum reprimere.

source: In this range, many of his abilities were restricted.
target: In hoc ambitu, multa eius facultātēs restrictae erant.

source: A handful of fiery crimson orbs, almost blindingly white, streaked past Camus, disappearing into the forest’s depths.
target: Paucīs globulīs rubriflōrentibus, paene eximē albis, trans Camum volitāvērunt, in profundum silvae evanescēntēs.

source: Rumble!
target: Rugitus!

source: Amidst the thunderous explosions, the gunfire abruptly ceased.
target: Inter tonitruōsōs explosiōnum strepitūs, sclopeta repentinē cessāvērunt.

source: Soon after, curses in Dutanese rang out from the forest’s depths.
target: Mox postea, maledicta Dutanica ex profundīs silvae resonāvērunt.

source: “Go to hell, you Northern Continent bandits!
target: “Abi ad inferos, vos latrōnēs Continentis Septentrionalis!”

source: “Rot with your sons of bitches!
target: “Putrescite, filīi canum!”

source: “Come after us if you have the guts!
target: “Venite post nōs, sī animōs habetis!”

source: Gradually, the curses faded into the forest’s depths.
target: Paulātim, maledicta in profundum silvae evanūērunt.

source: Lumian emerged from the shadows of the carriage, opting not to pursue.
target: Lumian e umbrīs vectūrae exiēvit, decernēns nōn insequī.

source: “It’s the Resistance! What are they doing in Matani…” Camus frowned, muttering to himself in confusion.
target: “Resistentia est! Quid in Matani faciunt…” Camus frontem contrāxit, inter sē, in confusiōne, murmurāns.

source: In the Southern Continent, numerous Resistance factions abounded.
target: In Continente Meridionali, numerōsae factionēs Resistantiae abundāvērunt.

source: He couldn’t discern which faction they belonged to or their motives.
target: Non poterat discernere cui factioni pertinerent aut quid propositum haberent.

source: Typically, Matani, ostensibly independent from the Intis Republic and governed by Admiral Querarill, a Southern Continent native, saw little Resistance activity.
target: Saepe, Matani, quae putābātur ab Intis Re Publicā separāta et ab Admirālī Querarill, indigēna Continentis Meridionalis regnāta, parvām Resistantiae activitātem videbat.

source: Their primary demand was the expulsion of colonists.
target: Prima eōrum postulātiō erat colōnos expellere.

source: Could it be a faction of the Resistance dedicated to Death, aiming to revive Death’s influence in Matani?
target: Num esset factiō Resistantiae morti dēdica­tā, quæ mortis potentiam in Matani revocāre studeret?

source: Please not the Rose School of Thought‑backed Resistance.
target: Quaeso, nē sit Resistantia ab Schola Rōsā Sententiarum sustināta.

source: No, those lunatics… Camus returned to the carriage, puzzled.
target: Non, illī insanientēs… Camus ad vectūrām rediit, perplexus.

source: Lumian mulled over another matter.
target: Lumian dē aliā rē meditātus est.

source: Despite attaining Sequence 5 status, life still felt fragile.
target: Quamquam Sequenciae V adeptus erat, vita tamen fragilis videbātur.

source: Vulnerable to being shot dead!
target: Vulnerābilis ad mortiferum sclopetōrum ictum!

source: If a Resistance member possessed sharpshooting skills and remained beyond his observational range, sniping from over 100 meters, they could have ended his life.
target: Si membrum Resistantiae callidās sclopetandī artes haberet et extra ambitum eius maneret, a centum metris ultra iacēns vitam eius finīre potuissēt.

source: Reapers lacked the resilient bodies of Devils.
target: Messōrēs corpora robusta Diabōlī non habēbant.

source: While lacking Malicious Perception, Devils might sustain only minor wounds from rifle shots.
target: Cum Malitiosam Perceptiōnem careant, Diabōlī sōlum modicōrum vulnerārum ex sclopetōrum ictibus ferre potēbant.

source: Their absence of long‑range Danger Premonition characteristic of Seer pathways rendered them unable to preemptively evade.
target: Eōrum deesse praevisiōnis periculi longī, quæ viis vāticīnātōrum notābilis est, eos impediēbat ut praevenīre possent.

source: Granted, Lumian’s Ascetic traits bolstered his spiritual perception.
target: Certe, virtūtēs ascēticae Lumiani perceptiōnem spiritualem eius corroborāvērunt.

source: Anticipating danger, he had foreseen the attack.
target: Praeveniēns periculum, impetum praenotāverat.

source: Yet, if the adversary could nullify his spiritual perception or manipulate it effectively, conventional rifles could indeed imperil Lumian.
target: Attamen, sī adversārius spiritualem perceptiōnem eius evellere aut bene moderārī posset, sclopeta ordināria vere Lumian in discrimen adducere potēbant.

source: Yes, Shadow Transformation can serve as a shield.
target: Ita, Transformatio Umbrārum scūtum esse potest.

source: Bullets lacking special effects pose no genuine threat to shadow beings…
target: Globulī, cuius effectūs specialēs deesse videntur, nullam minam veram entibus umbrārum inferunt.

source: Lumian redirected his thoughts, instructing Lugano, emerging from the carriage, “Check on the horse.”
target: Lumian cogitātiōnēs suās reorāvit, et Lugano, e vectūrā exiēns, iussit: “Examinā equum.”

source: If it survived, attend to its injuries promptly for carriage duty.
target: Sī superfuerit, celeriter vulnera eius curānda sunt ad officia vectūrae.

source: If not, Ludwig would command the equine corpse to pull the carriage.
target: Alioquī, Ludwig iubere equīnum cadāver trahere vectūrām daret.

source: After all, Ludwig had gained the ability to command a handful of low‑level undead from a concoction brewed from Hisoka’s eyeballs.
target: Postremō, Ludwig adeptus erat facultātem imperandī paucōs undead gradūs infīmōs ex mixtūra ex oculīs Hisoka cocta.
